music.title: Sunny Harvest Walk
music.prompt: Gentle acoustic guitar, soft felt piano, warm pizzicato strings, light woodwind melody, brushed percussion. Peaceful sunny countryside, welcoming and playful, 82 BPM. Instrumental only.
